svg.title: Beyond mise
svg.desc: Stacked area chart of cumulative GitHub stars since January 2025 for jdx's tools other than mise: 8.58k stars in total, about 1.09k a year earlier, mostly from tools launched since then. mr boxington 491, aube 2030, fnox 2259, hk 1258, pitchfork 680, usage 1055, +6 more 809.
